episode.title: Why They Launched a Subway Tunnel Like a Ship
episode.headline:
WHY LAUNCH
A SUBWAY TUNNEL?

beats.text: Why are they launching a tunnel like a ship?
This is nineteen sixty-seven, and these are pieces of BART’s Transbay Tube.
Built on land. Launched into the bay. Then towed into position.
The plan: lower the sections to make a railway tunnel between Oakland and San Francisco.
So that strange floating object? Part of a future train ride under the bay.
